falsified_hypotheses.statement: Turbulent vortex stretching in 3D Navier-Stokes is universally governed by 1D material thread models.
falsified_hypotheses.counterexample_summary: Sheet and swirl topologies dominate high-strain regimes where 1D thread assumptions fail.
falsified_hypotheses.surviving_scope: Material thread tracking remains a useful local Lagrangian diagnostic.
falsified_hypotheses.reopening_condition: Rigorous proof that 1D thread geometry emerges in an asymptotic singular limit.

falsified_hypotheses.statement: The Lagrangian vorticity growth rate is universally bounded by ln(q2/q1) <= int lambda_3 dt.
falsified_hypotheses.counterexample_summary: 12,862 subintervals in adversarial strained shear layers showed positive viscous logarithmic influx Vlog > 0 overcoming the strain gap.
falsified_hypotheses.surviving_scope: Holds as an upper bound in inviscid or purely compressive viscous regions.
falsified_hypotheses.reopening_condition: None for universal B1. Falsification is mathematically decisive.

falsified_hypotheses.statement: Realized vortex stretching is universally depleted below maximal strain by a fixed margin: lambda_w <= (1-delta) lambda_3 for some delta > 0.
falsified_hypotheses.counterexample_summary: Observed lambda_w / lambda_3 = 0.9991 with a3 > 0.99 in intense shear sheets.
falsified_hypotheses.surviving_scope: Statistical depletion remains substantial (61.5% average capacity reduction).
falsified_hypotheses.reopening_condition: None for universal static depletion. Falsification is mathematically decisive.

falsified_hypotheses.statement: The tested simple isotropic coherence-radius estimator establishes an invariant intrinsic physical scale R_coh for high-vorticity structures.
falsified_hypotheses.counterexample_summary: The tested simple isotropic coherence-radius estimator is grid-locked at approximately 1.0–1.2 dx across the tested 16^3 -> 32^3 refinement and therefore does not establish a resolved intrinsic physical coherence scale.
falsified_hypotheses.surviving_scope: Explicitly preserved as OPEN: anisotropic coherence scales, superlevel-set thickness, filtered scales, vortex-sheet thickness, vortex-tube thickness, higher-resolution physical scales.
falsified_hypotheses.reopening_condition: Testing anisotropic or filtered physical scale estimators on highly resolved meshes (e.g. 64^3 - 128^3).

falsified_hypotheses.statement: Selecting events by high realized strain alignment rho = lambda_w / lambda_3 >= 0.80 uniquely identifies runaway vorticity bursts.
falsified_hypotheses.counterexample_summary: 78.3% of rho >= 0.80 events were decaying or low-q fluctuations. True dangerous bursts require strict positive growth g(t) > 0 and q/qmax >= 0.95.
falsified_hypotheses.surviving_scope: High rho is an alignment indicator, not a growth burst indicator.
falsified_hypotheses.reopening_condition: None. Strict growth filtering g(t) > 0 is mathematically necessary.

falsified_hypotheses.statement: Finite-domain numerical blow-up rescaling establishes the existence of a global ancient solution on R^3 x (-infinity, 0].
falsified_hypotheses.counterexample_summary: Finite simulation times yield finite backward horizons T_n^- < infinity and finite uncontaminated radii R_valid. Limits are local space-time approximations on compact cylinders Q_R.
falsified_hypotheses.surviving_scope: Valid on compact parabolic cylinders Q_R = B_R(0) x (-R^2, 0] with R < R_valid.
falsified_hypotheses.reopening_condition: Rigorous analytical passage to the infinite whole-space limit.
